sloka: ताभ्यामर्ध्यं च पाद्यं च दत्त्वा पश्चात् फलानि च ।आनुपूर्व्याच्च धर्मज्ञ: पप्रच्छ कुशलं कुले ॥ २.९०.६
transliteration: tābhyāmardhyaṁ ca pādyaṁ ca dattvā paścāt phalāni ca ।ānupūrvyācca dharmajña: papraccha kuśalaṁ kule ॥ 2.90.6

translations.english: Offering them both in order arghya (welcomeoffering), water to wash their feet and fruits in accordance with the practice, he enquired Bharata about the welfare of the family.
